subject: [PATCH 07/60] mm/memory-tiers: restrict demotion topology to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the demotion topology to common memory, preventing nodes outside N_MEMORY_COMMON from being generic demotion sources or destinations. It also changes how demotion paths and DRAM performance references are built, focusing on N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of every node with memory.
